verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party docs describe event hooks as outbound HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify, sent when specified events occur in your org. That is a registrable webhook subscription a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: documentation of how hooks are registered (API or console), the list of subscribable event types, delivery details such as verification, retries and payload format, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Event hooks are outbound calls from Okta, sent when specified events occur in your org. They take the form of HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify
